findings.candidate: ADMET-EvO: a self-evolving scientific agent for sustained research across heterogeneous tasks
source_backed_facts: arXiv records v1 as submitted on 2026-09-09.

The abstract describes an evidence-gated scientific agent that formalizes endpoints, generates falsifiable hypotheses, tests interventions across data, feature and model axes, and carries supported, rejected and inconclusive outcomes into later cycles.

The authors report evaluation across the 22-task Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET benchmark, with a task-normalized score of 96.77 and a 72.2% reduction in cumulative fitting time within a predefined non-inferiority margin.
The abstract also reports formalization of 43 toxicity-related tasks with endpoint-specific predictors.
findings.research_value: High-value candidate for comparing persistent evidence memory, falsifiable-hypothesis generation, heterogeneous-task adaptation, and efficiency-aware evaluation in scientist-agent systems.
